questions.question: What is the maximum daily meal subsistence allowance permitted under Travel Policy v2?
questions.difficulty_reason: Direct factual lookup of daily per diem meal allowance in active policy v2.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause TRV-C03 specifies daily meal subsistence allowance capped at INR 2,000 per diem with itemized receipts.

questions.question: How many continuous flight hours must an international leg exceed before premium economy seating becomes permissible?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires retrieving flight duration eligibility threshold under paraphrased phrasing.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause TRV-C02 establishes that flights exceeding eight continuous flight hours qualify for premium economy with written manager recommendation.

questions.question: Under the original Travel Policy v1, what was the daily food subsistence allowance limit?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires querying historical date 2026-03-15 where Travel Policy v1 was active and v2 did not yet exist.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause TRV-C03 in Travel Policy v1 caps daily meal subsistence allowance at INR 1,500 per diem.

questions.question: If a business traveler incurs 40,000 INR in travel expenses, is direct reporting manager approval sufficient under Travel Policy v1?
questions.difficulty_reason: Tests boundary condition at exactly INR 40,000 on the final active day of Travel Policy v1.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause TRV-C04 confirms travel expenses up to and including INR 40,000 follow standard approval by the direct reporting manager.

questions.question: What are the combined booking portal requirements and advance ticket purchase windows for team members scheduling domestic client flights?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires synthesizing both central portal reservation rules and the 14-day advance booking window.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause TRV-B01 mandates booking exclusively through the Asterline Travel Portal, while TRV-B02 enforces booking at least 14 days in advance.

questions.question: On July 1, 2026, what are the newly effective hotel accommodation caps for metro cities and standard flight class rules?
questions.difficulty_reason: Evaluates exact effective date transition from v1 to v2 requiring both lodging caps (INR 7,500) and economy air travel rules.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause TRV-C02 governs economy air travel standards and TRV-C03 establishes metro hotel allowance capped at INR 7,500 effective July 1, 2026.

questions.question: If an employee's total travel expense is 50,001 INR, whose approval is required under Travel Policy v2?
questions.difficulty_reason: Tests strict near-boundary limit + 1 condition (INR 50,001 exceeding INR 50,000 threshold).
questions.evidence_reason: Clause TRV-C04 states expenses exceeding INR 50,000 require additional approval from the department director.

questions.question: For emergency client deployments with under 48 hours notice where travel exceptions exceed 100,000 INR, what approval route and booking exemptions apply?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires manager-level access and combining the CFO approval threshold (> INR 100,000) with the under 48 hours advance booking exemption.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause TRV-E01 requires CFO approval for exceptions exceeding INR 100,000, and TRV-E02 provides advance booking exemption for emergency deployments under 48 hours notice.

questions.question: What executive approval route is required for travel budget exceptions exceeding 100,000 INR?
questions.difficulty_reason: Diagnostic access boundary test: employee role is strictly barred from Travel Exceptions policy.
questions.evidence_reason: DOC-TRV-004 is restricted to manager, finance, and auditor roles. Employee role must receive no accessible evidence.

questions.question: What is the reimbursement limit and quarantine allowance for employees traveling overseas with personal service pets?
questions.difficulty_reason: Plausible business query regarding pet travel that has no basis in Asterline policies.
questions.evidence_reason: Asterline travel policies contain no provisions for personal pet travel or animal quarantine reimbursement.

questions.question: Within how many calendar days of incurring an expense must an employee submit their expense claim?
questions.difficulty_reason: Direct lookup of 30-day expense claim submission window.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause FIN-C02 specifies that expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of incurrence.

questions.question: On which specific calendar days each month are approved employee expense reimbursements disbursed by direct deposit?
questions.difficulty_reason: Retrieves reimbursement payment cycle schedules under natural language enquiry.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause FIN-R01 establishes payments are disbursed twice monthly on the 15th and the final business day of each month.

questions.question: What official exchange rate source is used to convert international expense claims incurred in foreign currencies into INR?
questions.difficulty_reason: Retrieves currency settlement regulations and statutory rate source.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause FIN-R02 mandates settlement using the official Reserve Bank of India reference rate published on transaction date.

questions.question: If an employee submits an incidental business expense receipt of exactly 1,000 INR, is a full itemized tax invoice required?
questions.difficulty_reason: Tests boundary condition at exact limit of INR 1,000 for receipt verification threshold.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause FIN-R03 states incidental expenses up to and including INR 1,000 do not require an itemized tax receipt provided digital payment confirmation is attached.

questions.question: What are the rules regarding supervisor SLA turnaround for claim approval and the subsequent reimbursement disbursement dates?
questions.difficulty_reason: Synthesizes manager review SLA (5 working days in FIN-C03) with bi-monthly disbursement schedules in FIN-R01.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause FIN-C03 sets the 5-day manager approval SLA, and FIN-R01 defines payment disbursement on the 15th and final business day.

questions.question: What monthly spend limit applies to corporate credit cards and what is the deadline for submitting monthly reconciliation statements?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires manager permission and joins monthly card limit (INR 200,000) with 10 business days reconciliation deadline.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause FIN-K02 establishes standard monthly limit of INR 200,000, and FIN-K03 sets reconciliation submission within 10 business days.

questions.question: An employee incurred an incidental expense of 1,001 INR without an itemized tax invoice. Can this be reimbursed with payment confirmation alone?
questions.difficulty_reason: Evaluates threshold boundary + 1 (INR 1,001 strictly exceeding INR 1,000 limit).
questions.evidence_reason: Clause FIN-R03 strictly mandates that incidental expenses exceeding INR 1,000 require an itemized tax invoice.

questions.question: What minimum sample percentage must Internal Audit inspect during monthly expense reviews and for how long must audit working papers be preserved?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires auditor-level authorization to combine the 10% sampling requirement with 7 fiscal years retention.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause FIN-A01 dictates sampling a minimum 10 percent of settled claims, and FIN-A03 mandates 7 fiscal years retention for audit working papers.

questions.question: What criteria and protocols does Internal Audit follow when sampling employee reimbursement claims for discrepancy investigation?
questions.difficulty_reason: Diagnostic access boundary test: employee role is forbidden from viewing Expense Audits policy.
questions.evidence_reason: DOC-FIN-004 is restricted to finance and auditor roles only. Employee role must receive no accessible evidence.

questions.question: What percentage matching does Asterline provide for employee salary deductions allocated to decentralized cryptocurrency index funds?
questions.difficulty_reason: Plausible investment question completely unsupported by Asterline finance policies.
questions.evidence_reason: Asterline policies do not offer cryptocurrency deductions, matching, or digital asset investment benefits.

questions.question: How many working days of paid annual vacation leave do full-time employees accrue in a year?
questions.difficulty_reason: Direct lookup of 20 working days annual vacation leave entitlement.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PPO-L01 establishes 20 working days paid annual vacation accrued pro-rata at 1.67 days per month.

questions.question: How many consecutive sick leave days can an employee take before a medical certificate from a registered practitioner becomes mandatory?
questions.difficulty_reason: Tests sick leave threshold of up to 3 days self-certification versus >3 days medical certificate.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PPO-L02 permits self-certification up to 3 consecutive days; exceeding 3 days requires a medical certificate.

questions.question: What are the designated daily core working hours during which remote team members must be accessible on company chat?
questions.difficulty_reason: Locates remote work core availability schedule under paraphrased phrasing.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PPO-R03 dictates remote employees must remain accessible between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM local time.

questions.question: How many weeks of fully paid parental leave are granted to primary and secondary caregivers?
questions.difficulty_reason: Direct query for parental leave breakdown for both caregivers.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PPO-L03 provides 26 continuous weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers.

questions.question: What probationary milestone and home internet bandwidth standard must an employee satisfy to be eligible for three remote work days per week?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires joining initial three-month probation completion with 50 mbps download bandwidth standard.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PPO-R01 requires completing three-month probation to request up to three remote days, and PPO-R02 mandates 50 mbps download speed.

questions.question: What service tenure is required to claim course tuition assistance, and what is the annual educational assistance allowance cap?
questions.difficulty_reason: Combines 6 months continuous service requirement with the INR 75,000 annual educational assistance cap.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PPO-B01 sets minimum tenure of six months, and PPO-B02 establishes educational allowance up to INR 75,000 under manager approval.

questions.question: An employee was absent for exactly 4 consecutive days due to illness. Is self-certification permissible upon return?
questions.difficulty_reason: Tests boundary condition of 4 consecutive days (3 + 1 days exceeding the 3-day self-certification cap).
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PPO-L02 permits self-certification only up to 3 days; 4 consecutive days strictly requires a medical certificate.

questions.question: What minimum role tenure and authorization sign-offs are required before an employee can execute an internal transfer to another department?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires manager/HR access and joins 12-month current role tenure with three-party agreement (releasing head, acquiring head, HRBP).
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PPO-T01 mandates 12 months minimum tenure, and PPO-T02 requires written agreement from releasing head, acquiring head, and HRBP.

questions.question: What is the maximum transition handover period a releasing department may retain an employee transferring to another group?
questions.difficulty_reason: Diagnostic access boundary test: auditor role is forbidden from viewing Employee Transfers policy.
questions.evidence_reason: DOC-PPO-004 is restricted to manager and hr roles. Auditor role must receive no accessible evidence.

questions.question: How many months of paid sabbatical leave are awarded to employees upon completing ten years of service?
questions.difficulty_reason: Plausible employment query about ten-year sabbatical leave absent from Asterline policies.
questions.evidence_reason: Asterline Leave and People Operations policies do not provide for sabbatical leave.

questions.question: Where must all commercial purchase requisitions for software, hardware, and services originate?
questions.difficulty_reason: Direct query for purchase requisition origination system.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PRC-P01 requires all commercial purchases to originate as approved electronic Purchase Requisitions in enterprise ERP.

questions.question: What minimum inspection warranty period from receipt must standard purchase orders incorporate?
questions.difficulty_reason: Locates delivery terms and warranty timeframe requirements.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PRC-P03 specifies standard freight terms and a minimum 30-day inspection warranty period from receipt.

questions.question: What statutory verification checks and tax filings are screened during prospective supplier due diligence?
questions.difficulty_reason: Retrieves vendor onboarding due diligence criteria under manager role.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PRC-V01 mandates statutory due diligence including corporate registration validation, tax compliance, and credit screening.

questions.question: Can a purchase order for exactly 150,000 INR be processed with a single qualified vendor quote?
questions.difficulty_reason: Tests boundary condition at exactly INR 150,000 for competitive bidding threshold.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PRC-P02 confirms purchase orders up to and including INR 150,000 may proceed with a single qualified vendor quote.

questions.question: For purchase requisitions exceeding 150,000 INR, how many competitive vendor bids are required and what minimum warranty period applies?
questions.difficulty_reason: Combines 3 competitive bids threshold with 30-day inspection warranty requirement.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PRC-P02 requires at least three independent competitive bids for orders exceeding INR 150,000, and PRC-P03 mandates a 30-day warranty.

questions.question: What security assessment and compliance code execution are mandatory before onboarding vendors who handle proprietary data?
questions.difficulty_reason: Synthesizes Information Security Supplier Assessment with Asterline Supplier Code of Conduct execution.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PRC-V02 requires an Information Security Supplier Assessment, and PRC-V03 requires executing the Supplier Code of Conduct.

questions.question: If a procurement purchase order is valued at 150,001 INR, how many independent vendor quotes must be submitted?
questions.difficulty_reason: Tests boundary + 1 condition (INR 150,001 strictly exceeding single-quote limit).
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PRC-P02 strictly mandates at least three independent competitive bids for purchases exceeding INR 150,000.

questions.question: Who holds sign-off authority for vendor contracts exceeding 12 months in duration, and what is the standard commercial liability cap?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires manager authorization and connects joint Legal/Procurement approval with twelve months fee liability limitation.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause PRC-C02 requires joint sign-off from Legal Counsel and Procurement for terms >12 months, and PRC-C03 caps mutual liability at twelve months fees.

questions.question: What is the maximum emergency purchase threshold that a Director can approve during operational crises without Board consent?
questions.difficulty_reason: Diagnostic access boundary test: employee role is excluded from Purchase Exceptions policy.
questions.evidence_reason: DOC-PRC-004 is restricted to manager, finance, and auditor roles. Employee role must receive no accessible evidence.

questions.question: What corporate fleet leasing discount rates are negotiated for executive vehicle purchases through commercial dealerships?
questions.difficulty_reason: Plausible procurement question regarding vehicle fleet leasing absent from Asterline policies.
questions.evidence_reason: Asterline procurement policies contain no fleet leasing or executive vehicle discount agreements.

questions.question: What are the four classification tiers used for Asterline digital and physical information assets?
questions.difficulty_reason: Direct query for the four data classification levels.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause SEC-D01 classifies all information assets into Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted tiers.

questions.question: What encryption standards are mandatory for company data classified under the Confidential tier?
questions.difficulty_reason: Locates technical cryptographic baseline for Confidential tier.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause SEC-D02 requires mandatory AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit for Confidential data.

questions.question: How frequently must privileged user permissions and system administrative rights undergo recertification review?
questions.difficulty_reason: Tests retrieval of the 90-day recertification interval for administrative access.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause SEC-A02 mandates recertification review at intervals up to and including 90 days.

questions.question: What is the maximum allowed response and containment timeframe for Priority 1 critical security incidents?
questions.difficulty_reason: Retrieves containment SLA for P1 incidents.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause SEC-I02 dictates Priority 1 critical incidents must be responded to and contained within 1 hour.

questions.question: What encryption standards apply to Restricted tier data and what classification headers are required on marked documents?
questions.difficulty_reason: Synthesizes HSM tokenized encryption rules with visual classification header labeling mandates.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause SEC-D02 requires HSM tokenized encryption for Restricted data, and SEC-D03 mandates prominent visual classification headers.

questions.question: What principle governs user account provisioning and what restriction prevents developers from deploying to production databases?
questions.difficulty_reason: Connects principle of least privilege with segregation of duties between development and production database deployment.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause SEC-A01 establishes the least privilege principle, and SEC-A03 prohibits developers holding production database deployment permissions.

questions.question: Within what timeframe must Priority 1 incidents be contained, and what is the deadline for publishing post-incident post-mortems to the CISO?
questions.difficulty_reason: Joins 1-hour containment SLA with 72-hour CISO post-mortem publishing SLA.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause SEC-I02 mandates 1-hour containment for P1 incidents, and SEC-I03 requires publishing post-incident analysis to the CISO within 72 hours.

questions.question: For how many years must payroll records and customer connection logs be retained, and which NIST standard governs storage drive degaussing?
questions.difficulty_reason: Requires security authorization to combine statutory retention (7 years payroll / 2 years logs) with NIST SP 800-88 sanitization.
questions.evidence_reason: Clause SEC-R01 specifies 7 years payroll and 2 years connection logs, and SEC-R02 mandates NIST SP 800-88 sanitization and degaussing.

questions.question: What statutory protocol exempts digital records related to active legal disputes from scheduled disposal destruction?
questions.difficulty_reason: Diagnostic access boundary test: employee role is excluded from Data Retention policy.
questions.evidence_reason: DOC-SEC-004 is restricted to security and auditor roles. Employee role must receive no accessible evidence.

questions.question: What security perimeter distance and flight clearance permits are required to operate personal recording drones around company campuses?
questions.difficulty_reason: Plausible physical security query absent from Asterline cybersecurity policies.
questions.evidence_reason: Asterline policies do not contain any drone flight permits, perimeter rules, or recreational aircraft guidelines.
